'''Tellas Lordin''' was an individual who had a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on their head that was claimed by the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Moxin Tark]]. The acquisition impressed [[Imperial Prefect]] [[Adrona]].
